phrases: 表示过去的习惯性动作或状态，现在已不再继续
He used to work in a small shop.
他过去在一家小商店工作。
Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
Frank was telling me about his experiences.
In 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
1958年他买下了自己的一个小车间。
In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
Frank在二十多岁时制造飞机配件。
In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory.
几年之后这个小车间变成了一个大工厂。
He remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.
他想起了早年艰难的岁月和通往成功的漫漫长路。
She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
她想让他修理他们孙子的自行车！
At that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
在那时他每天工作十四个小时。

grammar.f: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
grammar.d: used to 表示过去经常性的动作或存在的状态，而现在已经不再发生或存在了 用于描述过去的习惯、状态或行为，与现在形成对比
ex: He used to work in a small shop.
他过去在一家小商店工作（现在不在了）。
Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
She used to be a teacher.

grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时间发生的动作或存在的状态 用于叙述过去发生的事情，常与 yesterday, last week, in 1958 等时间状语连用
ex: In 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
1958年他买下了自己的一个小车间。
Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years.
Frank想起早年艰难的岁月时笑了。

grammar.f: 主句 + when + 从句（过去时）
grammar.d: when引导的时间状语从句表示主句的动作发生在从句动作的过程中 when 从句常用一般过去时，主句可用过去进行时或一般过去时
ex: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years.
Frank想起早年艰难的岁月时笑了。
He was still smiling when the door opened.

patterns.p: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
o: He used to work in a small shop.
他过去在一家小商店工作。
im: She used to live in Beijing.
I used to play tennis when I was young.

patterns.p: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + when + 主语 + 动词过去式
o: He was still smiling when the door opened.
im: She was reading when I came in.
They were having dinner when the phone rang.
电话响的时候他们正在吃晚饭。

patterns.p: In + 年份/时间, 主语 + 动词过去式
o: In 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
1958年他买下了自己的一个小车间。
im: In 2020, she started her own business.
In his thirties, he became a manager.
在他三十多岁时，他成为了一名经理。
